title: GRANBLUE FANTASY The Animation Season 2 Specials
justification: AniList 116968 (SPECIAL, 2 episodes, 2020-03-28 to 2020-08-26) is AniDB 13524's specials S1 Mouhitotsu no Tabiji (Another Journey, 2020-03-28) and S2 Kourin! Cypher Mask! / Sei Albion Onna Gakuen Monogatari (The Masked Cypher Descends! / A Tale of St. Albion Girls' Academy, 2020-08-26). AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 107346, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 13524, and the special titles match AniList's synonyms (Another Journey; The Masked Cypher Descends! / A Tale of St. Albion Girls' Academy). The parent's row places them on TVDB 0x3 One More Journey (2020-03-27, one day earlier) and 0x4 (2020-08-26) and, with the TMDB rows, on TMDB 69820 S0E3 and S0E4 (2020-03-28 and 2020-08-26).
